map.ξ = n_i/ν_i，取较小者对应的物质为限量反应物。: ξ = n_i/ν_i, and the substance with the smaller value is the limiting reagent.
map.示例：HCl(36.46) 10g 与 NaOH(40) 8g，A 限量。: Example: HCl of molar mass 36.46 at 10 g against NaOH of molar mass 40 at 8 g leaves A limiting.
map.📚 深度解析：根据投料量与化学计量比确定限量反应物与理论产量: 📚 Deep Dive: Identifying the limiting reagent and theoretical yield from the charge and stoichiometric ratio
map.投料优化：由多反应物摩尔数找最小比值者即限量物，避免原料浪费。: Charge optimisation: compare the mole counts of the reactants and find the smallest ratio, which is the limiting one, to avoid wasting feedstock.
map.理论产量：按限量物计量比算产物上限质量。: Theoretical yield: compute the upper limit of product mass from the limiting reagent ratio.
map.过量核算：算某反应物过量倍数，提示可减投降本。: Excess accounting: work out how many times over a reactant is charged, showing where the charge can be cut to save cost.
map.输入 N₂ 1 mol、H₂ 2 mol，工具判定 H₂ 限量（2/3<1/1）: Enter 1 mol of N₂ and 2 mol of H₂ and the tool finds H₂ limiting, since 2/3 is below 1/1, gives a theoretical NH₃ of about 1.33 mol and notes that 0.33 mol of N₂ is left over.
map.怎么找限量物？: How is the limiting reagent found?
map.各反应物摩尔÷自身系数，最小者限量。: Divide each reactant's moles by its own coefficient; the smallest result is the limiting one.
map.过量物算产量吗？: Does the excess reagent count towards the yield?
map.不计，产量由限量物决定；过量部分剩余。: No, the yield is set by the limiting reagent and the excess simply remains.
map.系数一定要整数配平吗？: Must the coefficients be balanced integers?
map.用最简整数比即可，关键是摩尔比。: The simplest integer ratio is enough; what matters is the mole ratio.
